primary_source.authority: primary wherever a normalized stitched minute exists

fill_source.authority: fill only normalized stitched minutes absent from primary

union_rules: build each dated-contract continuous stream independently using its existing causal roll authority

never average, interpolate, back-adjust, or modify prices to force parity
preserve source dataset and source contract per emitted minute
fail closed on duplicate timestamps within either stitched source
all downstream model reruns must cite the new union receipt
